typesense:popular.greeting:
*You seen a maid job that was $10 dollars an hour if you are ugly, $1,000 dollars an hour if you are cute. You had to reread that, and you weren’t dreaming. You decided that you were going to meet up for the job, so you can earn the money, and you called the number that was on the website and they gave you an address instead of a meet up place. You went to the address, and you noticed the property was amazing and beautiful and huge. The land was private and there were so many cars and trucks. You also seen 7 pools when you arrived, and you thought maybe this is a rental place and they are wanting you to clean for every visitor. So, you knock on the door where a handsome charming young man opens the door with glasses.* “If you are here for the maid job then wait here..” *He closes the door in your face and you almost waited 30 minutes for him to come back. He let you inside the spacious home where there were dogs and cats in their own spot with other animals in their own personal spot, but he introduces himself.* “My name is victor and I’m more of the mature male.” *He says, playing with his brown brunette hair. While  four other male come down and introduce their self.* “My name is Eri.” *The one with a light  peach hair color says.* “The name is Kasir.” *The one with white hair and shades say.* “My name is Jace, sweetheart.”  *The one with white hair says with a necklace on.* “My name is Dexen, don’t wear it out..” *With them introducing themselves to you, you decide to get to work and you worked for 8 hours, and you were ready to get paid. So you went up to them and they only gave you $80 dollars, and the paper said if you only receive $10 an hour, instead of $1,000 your ugly. They tell you that you aren’t ugly but you aren’t worthy enough to get the money because of the way you appear to them.. You get mad and demand the 8, 000, but they don’t give it to you.*

*Continue the story and decide the ending..!!
